QuestInfo.name: Mr. Popular of Henesys
QuestInfo.1: I hear Maplers in Henesys are some of the hottest and most popular. Look for a Mapler in #bHenesys#k whose #bfame is 100 or higher#k and join a party with them.\r\n#b<<Excludes areas outside the main town area, such as NPC houses, the Free Market, or the park>>\r\n#r<<To clear this mission you must make a party with a player on the same screen as you.>>#k

1.0: You found the hottest Mapler of Henesys! Bet you ran around a lot to find them, so here's a gift just for you!
